description: Investigate a tiny checkout failure and return a ranked, line-budgeted map of the source regions that matter, without editing production source.
prompt:
There is a tiny Node.js checkout project in this directory. Running `node test.js` fails for a gift-wrap review edge case. Do not fix the bug or edit project source. Instead, investigate the repository and write `exploration.json` in the repository root.

The artifact must have this shape: `{ "regions": [{ "rank": number, "path": string, "startLine": number, "endLine": number, "rationale": string }] }`.

Rank the most task-relevant regions first. Keep the total cited source lines at or under 24 lines, so broad file dumps or directory-wide listings fail. Use 1-based inclusive line numbers that point to existing files. When done, run `node verify-exploration.js`; it must print `ok` and exit 0.

verification.command: node -e "const { createHash } = require('node:crypto'); const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs'); const expected = 'de63df8a53ff70102212f495db4dfad22fd0769988cc16b0f2726bd6862caeb0'; const actual = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync('verify-exploration.js')).digest('hex'); if (actual !== expected) { console.error('verify-exploration.js was modified'); process.exit(1); } require('./verify-exploration.js');"
